metadata.compatibility_policy: Solo compatible/incompatible cuando la relación o interfaz está explícitamente documentada.
metadata.description: Base técnica maestra de componentes para BiciFirme – Repara tu bici.
metadata.editorial.review: Workbook remains development; RobMac editorial review is required before changing status to approved.; Park Tool is used only as an authoritative secondary source for generic thread/valve dimensions where a standards-body or manufacturer-neutral primary source was not available in this pass.; No torque, wear limit, minimum rotor thickness, oil volume, service interval or repair procedure was added unless it was required by scope and explicitly sourced; those fields are deliberately absent rather than guessed.; Rows with pipe-separated option values represent explicit manufacturer-listed options, not proof that every cross-combination of those options exists.; Official Comp ErgoMax → C260 incompatibility remains deliberately unrepresented in COMPATIBILITIES: Ritchey publishes the restriction against the C260 family/platform, while schema v1 supports component/standard endpoints but not component↔family compatibility. It should be modeled only after family_id compatibility endpoints are supported.
metadata.id_policy: IDs estables, minúsculos, sin espacios y no dependientes del número de fila.
metadata.import_policy: Una fila por registro; sin fórmulas necesarias para interpretación; tablas con encabezado, filtro y fila congelada.
metadata.no_inference_policy: No inferir por marca, familia, número de velocidades, dimensiones parecidas ni relaciones transitivas.
metadata.note.compatibility_policy: La ausencia de fila en COMPATIBILITIES nunca significa incompatible.
metadata.note.content_version: Initial broad V1 dataset assembled from verified authoritative sources.
metadata.note.description: Identificación, estándares, especificaciones, compatibilidades explícitas y consumibles; no contiene reparaciones.
metadata.note.editorial.review: Review these notes before promoting content status.
metadata.note.excluded_content: La base técnica y la base de reparaciones se mantienen separadas.
metadata.note.id_policy: Caracteres usados: a-z, 0-9, punto, guion y guion bajo.
metadata.note.import_policy: Campos EAV de SPECIFICATIONS guardan value como texto para mantener un tipo consistente.
metadata.note.no_inference_policy: Una opción publicada no se convierte en compatibilidad universal.
metadata.note.pending.deliberate: Deliberately pending; coverage gaps are reported explicitly rather than filled with invented data.
metadata.note.schema_version: Schema for the ten master-data sheets defined by the BiciFirme technical-base specification.
metadata.note.scope: Sistemas eléctricos específicos de e-bike excluidos de esta versión.
metadata.note.source_policy: Cada dato crítico de SPECIFICATIONS tiene source_id.
metadata.note.status: Do not change to approved until RobMac editorial review is complete.
metadata.note.unit_policy: No se convierten automáticamente valores oficiales entre unidades.
metadata.note.unknown_policy: No se rellenan huecos con aproximaciones.
metadata.note.validation.checks: Executed against the edited workbook and repeated after XLSX export/re-import; pass_structural is retained only if the final exported workbook returns exactly 0 errors.
metadata.note.validation.status: Post-edit structural validation completed 2026-09-06: 0 errors across duplicate IDs, ID syntax, manufacturer/family/component/source/standard references, critical/source rules, compatibility endpoints/results/sources, HTTPS source URLs, canonical property names, unit sentinels, README counts, metadata invariants, and explicit C260 proxy-removal checks.
metadata.pending.deliberate: V1 coverage still needs expansion in: front derailleur models and exact mounting/pull compatibility; brake inner cables and brake housing with exact cable-head/end standards; standalone freehub bodies; hydraulic olives, barbs/inserts and family-specific fittings; fixed-gear sprockets and lockrings with exact verified thread interfaces; commercial headset assemblies beyond SHIS standard records; dropper seatposts and remote/cable interfaces; rear shocks and mounting hardware; exact internal-gear hubs; additional rim-brake families (caliper, cantilever, U-brake, road direct-mount); quick-release skewers as standalone components; and other manufacturer-specific V1 gaps already identified. No placeholder technical values were added.
metadata.purpose: Responder qué componente es, qué estándar usa, qué especificaciones importan y qué reemplazo puede identificarse con evidencia.
metadata.sheet.COMPONENTS: Tabla central de piezas y variantes documentadas.
metadata.sheet.COMPONENT_CONSUMABLES: Relaciones verificadas entre componente y consumible.
metadata.sheet.FAMILIES: Familias/plataformas técnicas; no implican compatibilidad interna.
metadata.sheet.MANUFACTURERS: Fabricantes con componentes documentados en esta V1.
metadata.sheet.README: Metadatos, políticas, cobertura, pendientes y estado de validación.
metadata.sheet.SPECIFICATIONS: Una especificación por fila, con source_id y bandera critical.
metadata.sheet.STANDARDS: Identidades de interfaces, medidas y estándares reutilizables.
metadata.source_policy: Prioridad: fabricante/documentación técnica oficial; luego organismo del estándar; secundaria autoritativa solo cuando hace falta.
metadata.unit_policy: Preservar unidades publicadas; mm, in, bar y psi se normalizan con esas etiquetas cuando la fuente las publica.
metadata.unknown_policy: Vacío significa no documentado en esta V1; ausencia de compatibilidad significa unknown.
